spans.s:
mn. (-डः-डं)
An iron chain for the feet, a fetter, but especially the heel chains of an elephant.
E.
नि not, गड to drop, (to drop off,) affix अच्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Bound, tied, chained, &c.
E.
निगड a chain, इतच् aff.

m. (-णः)
The smoke of a burnt offering or sacrificial fire.
E.
नि implying certainty, prefixed to गण to estimate, affix क; by which the presence of fire is indicated.

m. (-दः)
1 Speech, speaking, discourse.
2 Audible recitation of prayers or charms.
E.
नि affirmative prefix, गद speech.

m. (-दः)
Speech, discourse.
E.
नि before गद to speak, affix घञ्; also निगद.

mfn. (-दन्-दन्ती-दत्)
Speaking, saying, speaking to, addressing.
E.
निगद to speak, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Said, spoken.
E.
नि before गद to speak, क्त aff.

mfn. (-वान्-नती-वत्)
Speaking, having spoken.
E.
नि before गद to speak, क्तवतु aff.

m. (-मः)
1 A town, a city.
2 A market, a fair.
3 Holy-writ, the Vedas collectively.
4 A road, a market road.
5 Trade, traffick.
6 A camp or caravan of itinerant dealers, as Banjaras, &c.
7 Certainty, assurance.
E.
नि affirmative prefix, गम to go, affix घ; by which people go, &c.

n. (-नं)
1 Certain or logical conclusion, the winding up of a syllogism.
2 Going.
E.
नि, and गमन going.

m. (-रः)
Eating, swallowing.
E.
नि in, गॄ to swallow, affix अप्.

m. (-रः)
Swallowing.
E.
नि prefixed to गॄ to swallow, affix घञ्; also निगर.

n. (-णं)
Eating, swallowing.
m. (-णः)
1 The throat, the gullet.
2 Smoke of a burnt offering.
E.
नि prefixed to गॄ to swallow, affix ल्युट्.

m. (-लः)
The throat or neck of a horse.
E.
नि before गल to eat, affix घञ्.

m. (-वान्)
A horse.
E.
निगाल as above, and मतुप् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Sung, said.
E.
नि, and गीत sung.

m. (-गुः)
The mind, the faculty of feeling and reasoning.
E.
नि affirmation, गम to go, affix डु.

mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं)
1 Profound, obscure.
2 Hidden, concealed.
m. (-ढः)
A sort of wild bean: see मुद्ग.
E.
नि before गुह to hide or conceal, affix क्त.

mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं)
Having a hidden sense or purpose.
E.
निगूढ, and अर्थ meaning.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
1 To be hid or concealed.
2 To be protected or defended.
E.
नि before गुह to conceal, अनीयर् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Assailed, attacked.
2 Harassed, spoiled.
3 Seized, arrested.
4 Restrained, subdued, checked.
E.
नि before ग्रह to take, क्त aff.

f. (-तिः)
Restraint, check, &c.: see निग्रह.
E.
नि before ग्रह to take, क्तिन् aff.

mfn. (-ह्णन्-ह्णन्ती-ह्णत्)
1 Seizing, taking.
2 Suppressing, restraining.
E.
नि before ग्रह to take, शतृ aff.

ind.
1 Having taken.
2 Having restrained or suppressed.
3 Having arrested or confined.
E.
नि before ग्रह to take, ल्यप् aff.

m. (-हः)
1 Aversion, disfavour, discouragement, dislike.
2 Abusing, blaming.
3 Binding, confinement, capture, arrest.
4 A binding, a tie.
5 Restraint, subjugation.
6 Suppression, putting down.
7 A boundary, a limit.
8 Administering medicine.
9

Killing.
10

A name of KṚṢṆA.
E.
नि before ग्रह to take or seize, affix अप्.

m. (-हः)
Aversion, &c. used as an imprecation, as निग्राहस्ते भूयात् confusion seize you, &c.
E.
नि before ग्रह to seize, affix घञ्.

n. (-णं)
1 Subduing, suppression.
2

Defeat.
3

Capture.
E.
नि before ग्रह to take, ल्युट् aff.

n. (-नं)
Failure in logical argument.
E.
निग्रह, and स्थान place.
